baseFrontend: validated Admin 7 runtime with NexoWatt EOS role, login, overview and service-reserve hardening
label: v89
notes: 7.9.89 is the accepted stable sales-product release and is intended for npm dist-tag latest.
Installer and Guest/End User perform their one-time passwordless activation inside the normal login card, then must create a personal password.
Admin/Service retains the configured password and is excluded from passwordless activation and role reset.
EOS Assist is integrated into the header and account management exists only under Zugänge & Rechte.
The current tab-intro overview is modernized; the Easy overview is not used.
The internal admin and BackItUp emergency reserve are restricted to Admin/Service; NexoWatt Backup remains available to approved roles.
EOS Admin defaults to port 8081; the internal legacy admin remains protected on 127.0.0.1:18081.
changes: Integrates role selection into the normal login card and removes the separate passwordless-first-login panel.
Moves EOS Assist into the top header and removes overlapping floating launchers.
Keeps account and password reset functions exclusively under Zugänge & Rechte.
Modernizes the current overview for Admin, Installer and Guest/End User without using Easy mode.
Restricts exact official admin and backitup adapter/instance visibility and control to Admin/Service at UI, socket and object ACL layers.
Keeps NexoWatt Backup visible and usable for approved installer and end-user roles.
Retains Admin/Service-only expert mode, service settings and security administration.
Publishes the final stable package through npm latest with exact version and package validation.
